title: L4 — τ²-bench pass^4 against ALTK-Evolve
notes: Source: ./packages/eval/src/bin/tau2-driver.ts (driver form). Two arms must share the split; the reference number is ALTK-Evolve on τ²-retail.
pass^4 is the unbiased C(c,4)/C(n,4) mean over 68 tasks, with success defined as `reward == 1.0` exactly, as upstream scores it.
The split covers the minimum: 68 scored tasks.
